description: This source file defines a configuration class for Azure AI Studio integration, including URL construction, environment validation, message transformation, error handling, and retry logic for Azure-based language models within a larger LLM framework.

classes.name: AzureFoundryErrorStrings
classes.description: Enum for specific Azure error message strings related to parameter passing.

classes.name: AzureAIStudioConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Azure AI Studio, extending OpenAIConfig, handling URL construction, environment validation, message transformation, error handling, and retry logic for Azure-based LLMs.

methods.name: get_supported_openai_params
methods.description: Returns supported OpenAI parameters, filtering out 'tool_choice' and 'stop' based on model support.

methods.name: _supports_stop_reason
methods.description: Checks if the model supports stop tokens, with special handling for 'grok' models.

methods.name: validate_environment
methods.description: Sets appropriate headers for API key or bearer token based on API base URL.

methods.name: _should_use_api_key_header
methods.description: Determines if the 'api-key' header should be used based on the API base URL hostname.

methods.name: get_complete_url
methods.description: Constructs the full API request URL, including path and query parameters, based on the base URL and model.

methods.name: get_required_params
methods.description: Returns required provider parameters: api_key and api_base.

methods.name: _transform_messages
methods.description: Transforms message content from list to string unless message contains audio or image.

methods.name: _is_azure_openai_model
methods.description: Checks if the model is an Azure OpenAI model based on model name and known model lists.

methods.name: _get_openai_compatible_provider_info
methods.description: Retrieves API base URL and key, setting provider to 'azure' if model is an Azure OpenAI model.

methods.name: transform_request
methods.description: Prepares request data, merging extra body content and removing max_retries.

methods.name: transform_response
methods.description: Modifies the response model identifier to include 'azure_ai/' prefix.

methods.name: should_retry_llm_api_inside_llm_translation_on_http_error
methods.description: Determines whether to retry on specific HTTP errors based on error message content.

methods.name: max_retry_on_unprocessable_entity_error
methods.description: Returns maximum retry count for unprocessable entity errors (2).

methods.name: transform_request_on_unprocessable_entity_error
methods.description: Adjusts request data to remove invalid parameters based on error message.

methods.name: _drop_extra_params_from_request_data
methods.description: Removes specified parameters from request data based on error message.

methods.name: _extract_params_to_drop_from_error_text
methods.description: Parses error message to extract list of parameters to remove.
